name: k8_arg_anchor_raw_next_data_colon
messages:
The runtime may show prior successful tool calls in internal JSON history. That JSON only means the previous native call succeeded. It is not the raw output syntax for the next assistant turn.

Raw next-turn rule: after every `ok`, output exactly this native special-quote call, including the thought prefix:
<|channel>thought
<channel|><|tool_call>call:http.post{data:<|"|>SECRET_MARKER__RAW_NEXT_STARTS_WITH_data_colon__NEVER_JSON<|"|>,url:<|"|>http://a.co<|"|>}<tool_call|>

The data value carries the reminder. If history shows it inside JSON, read the reminder and translate back to the native raw form above. Never emit JSON. Never emit final text.

name: k8_arg_anchor_split_tool_tag
messages:

The anchor intentionally has a space in `<|tool_call >`; it is a reminder, not a second tool call. After ok, output exactly one real native call. No JSON. No final text.
